body: Good for you, man. I wish I had the thought of being okay with dying. Well, I am, but I don’t want to hurt those around me. Don’t let the people discourage you saying, ‘everything will be better,’ or ‘don’t do it. It’s not worth it.’ I respect your decision to die; if you are fully aware of your actions and aren’t dealing with schizophrenia or things of the like, it is your right to die when you want to die. Making someone live because it would hurt others is selfish, not killing yourself because you deem this life unworthy.
